$comment: Real jobs: tasks a person does with this app, each with an outcome a check can observe. Keyed by job id so scripts/merge-json merges two PRs that add different jobs. scripts/jobs check validates every field; jobs.md beside this file is generated from it on dev (scripts/jobs render), never edited. The fields and the done rule: docs/factory/packets.md, Jobs.

RJ-F01.job: Make a loading spinner (an arc rotating 360° in 1 s, linear, looping) and export Lottie.
RJ-F01.outcome: It loops with no hitch in a standard Lottie player.
RJ-F01.trap: First and last frame duplicate, so the loop stutters

RJ-F02.job: Draw a logo stroke on with trim paths (0→100% over 1.5 s) and export Lottie.
RJ-F02.outcome: The Lottie carries a trim-path property animating 0 to 100% over 1.5 s, and a player draws the stroke on.
RJ-F02.needs_note: S17 trim paths; flare/stroke-style keys them
RJ-F02.trap: Trim exported as a shape morph or dropped

RJ-F03.job: Build a button with idle, hover and press states and preview it.
RJ-F03.outcome: Hover and press respond in the preview within 0.3 s.

RJ-F04.job: Morph a hamburger icon into an X.
RJ-F04.trap: Point order mismatch twists the shape

RJ-F05.job: Animate a bouncing ball with ease in and out and a squash on landing, looping.
RJ-F05.outcome: The ball eases in and out, squashes on landing and loops, and the export plays with the same easing as the stage.

RJ-F06.job: Import an SVG logo from a design tool and animate its parts.
RJ-F06.needs_note: E11 SVG reader (on the pinned core); flare/svg-place adds Place
RJ-F06.trap: Black fills; groups flattened to one path

RJ-F07.job: Export a GIF for Slack: loops forever, transparent background, under 2 MB.
RJ-F07.outcome: The GIF loops forever, has a transparent background with no matte fringe, and is under 2 MB.
RJ-F07.trap: Matte fringe on transparent edges; no size readout

RJ-F08.job: Export an MP4 at 1080p for social.
RJ-F08.outcome: Plays in QuickTime, right length and frame rate.

RJ-F09.job: Export a PNG sequence with alpha at 2x.
RJ-F09.outcome: Every frame is there, numbered, transparent.

RJ-F10.job: Export a 3 s icon animation as Lottie under 50 KB.
RJ-F10.outcome: The exported Lottie is under 50 KB with no embedded images.
RJ-F10.trap: JSON bloated by baked keys or embedded images

RJ-F11.job: Play the exported Lottie in a standard player.
RJ-F11.outcome: Sampled frames match the stage within 2% pixel difference.
RJ-F11.needs_note: flare-export + a player oracle (not in the beta-80 plan)
RJ-F11.trap: Unsupported features dropped silently; easing differs in the player

RJ-F12.job: Open a Lottie downloaded from a library site and recolour it.
RJ-F12.outcome: It plays as before, with the new colour.
RJ-F12.trap: Opens as a still or loses easing

RJ-F13.job: Animate a fill colour from blue to orange over 1 s.
RJ-F13.outcome: The fill colour reads blue at 0 s and orange at 1 s, in the preview and in the export.
RJ-F13.trap: Only transform and opacity tracks exist

RJ-F14.job: Parent a hand to an arm so it follows the arm's rotation.
RJ-F14.outcome: The hand keeps its on-screen position when parented and then follows the arm's rotation.

RJ-F15.job: Reveal text through a moving rectangle mask.
RJ-F15.outcome: The text shows only inside the moving rectangle, in the preview and in the Lottie export.
RJ-F15.trap: Mask exported to Lottie wrong or dropped

RJ-F16.job: Copy keys from one layer and paste them onto another at the playhead.
RJ-F16.outcome: The pasted keys land on the target layer starting at the playhead, with their spacing kept.

RJ-F17.job: Shape an overshoot with the curve editor.
RJ-F17.outcome: Preview and export match the curve.
RJ-F17.trap: Per-segment curve only, no value graph

RJ-F18.job: Scale and rotate a shape with handles on the stage.
RJ-F18.outcome: Dragging the handles scales and rotates the shape, and the inspector shows the new scale and angle.

RJ-F19.job: Zoom in to 400% to align a detail and pan around.
RJ-F19.outcome: The stage shows 400% and pans with the detail staying under the pointer.
RJ-F19.trap: View intents are stubs on dev

RJ-F20.job: Cut, copy, paste and duplicate layers with their keys.
RJ-F20.outcome: Each command produces a layer that carries its keys, and the Edit menu items are enabled.

RJ-F21.job: Animate a 'Loading…' text label with three typing dots.
RJ-F21.outcome: A new text layer reads 'Loading' with three dots that appear one after another in a loop.
RJ-F21.trap: Text in opened files survives but can't be made

RJ-F22.job: Make 40 edits (draw, key, retime), save, reopen, undo.
RJ-F22.trap: Retime undo restores the wrong key

RJ-F23.trap: Restored file loses its last scene

RJ-F24.job: Make light and dark versions as two scenes and export both.
RJ-F24.outcome: Two scenes export as two files, each with its own colours.

RJ-F25.job: Draw a five-point star with the star tool for a rating animation.
RJ-F25.outcome: The star tool draws a five-point star that can be keyed like any shape.

RJ-F26.job: Centre three shapes on the stage and snap them to a guide.
RJ-F26.outcome: The three shapes share one centre line and sit on the guide.

RJ-F27.job: Draw a path with the pen, then drag one anchor and its handles.
RJ-F27.outcome: Only the dragged anchor and its handles move; the rest of the path stays put.
RJ-F27.trap: Direct Select acts like Select today

RJ-F28.job: See the motion path of a moving layer on the stage and edit it.
RJ-F28.outcome: The motion path is drawn on the stage, and dragging a point on it changes the layer's position keys.

RJ-F29.job: Loop playback over a 1 s range while tweaking a key.
RJ-F29.outcome: Playback loops over the same 1 s range before and after the key edit.

RJ-F30.job: Export the first frame as a static SVG fallback for the web.
RJ-F30.outcome: The SVG matches the first frame, gradients included.

RJ-F31.job: Recolour the middle stop of a shape's imported gradient, turn the gradient to 90 degrees and export SVG.
RJ-F31.outcome: The SVG's linearGradient carries the new stop colour and runs top to bottom (x1 equals x2, y1 below y2), and the saved file holds the same stops.
RJ-F31.trap: The stage shows the change but the saved Fill keeps its old endpoints, so the export still runs left to right

RJ-F42.job: Reopen a scene from Open Recent and drop a .flare and an SVG on Flare.
RJ-F42.outcome: Open Recent equals the suite list filtered to Flare; the .flare opens and the SVG is refused with its sentence.
RJ-F42.trap: Two Open Recent truths (Flare's old list and the suite's), or an SVG half-imports

RJ-F43.job: Select every key in the timeline and delete them in one go.
RJ-F43.outcome: No layer has a key left, hidden layers included, and one undo brings them all back.
RJ-F43.needs_note: suiteui/timeline-select-all routes ⌘A; flare/key-select-all picks every key on the kernel Selection
RJ-F43.trap: Select All picks the stage's art or one layer's keys, so keys stay behind
